An elite '''unit''' of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] served under [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Galo Thriven]] and struck at vulnerable [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] targets during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GatORW" /> Though trained to evade capture, these soldiers were prepared to [[Death/Legends|kill themselves]] if apprehended to preserve Thule's status as a hidden [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> and [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]]<ref name="TCSWE241">{{CSWECite|III|241-242|Thule}}</ref> and prevent information about the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from falling into the wrong hands.<ref name="GatORW" />
